about.title: About The Pullup Gallery
about.description: A global art experience through augmented reality

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: We're on a mission to make art accessible to everyone, everywhere. By combining traditional art with cutting-edge augmented reality technology, we create immersive experiences that bridge the gap between physical and digital art.

step1.title: Find Art
step1.description: Discover art locations near you or explore our global gallery of featured artists and their works.

step2.title: View in AR
step2.description: Use your smartphone to view artworks in augmented reality, bringing them to life in your space.

step3.title: Share & Connect
step3.description: Share your favorite pieces with friends and connect with artists from around the world.

contact.title: Get in Touch
contact.description: Have questions or want to collaborate? We'd love to hear from you.
